user.title: GIF
user.description: No configuration is needed. Submit to add the integration. The gif.create_gif action will then be available.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

create_gif.name: Create GIF
create_gif.description: Create an animated GIF from image files or from a camera entity.

images.name: Images
images.description: List of image file paths. At least two images are required. Mutually exclusive with camera. Mixed sizes are resized to the first frame.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera entity to snapshot. Mutually exclusive with images. Use with count and interval.

count.name: Count
count.description: Number of snapshots to capture in camera mode (2–60). Defaults to 10. Ignored when using images.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Seconds between snapshots in camera mode (0.1–10). Defaults to 0.5. Ignored when using images.

fps.name: FPS
fps.description: Frames per second of the output GIF (1–60). Defaults to 10.

output_path.name: Output path
output_path.description: Optional path to save the GIF. Defaults to /config/www/gif/ using the camera id and a timestamp in camera mode, or images and a timestamp in images mode.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Whether the GIF should loop. Defaults to on.

not_setup.message: The GIF integration is not set up. Add it under Settings → Devices & services.

source_exclusive.message: images and camera are mutually exclusive; provide one or the other.

source_required.message: Provide either images (at least 2 file paths) or a camera entity.

interval_invalid.message: Interval must be a number of seconds.

interval_range.message: Interval must be between 0.1 and 10 seconds.
